title: Student in Customer Capabilities
description_md:
Launch your career at the crossroads of business and technology, where you will bridge the gap between business needs and technical solutions. This role offers the perfect opportunity to develop your analytical skills while working alongside experienced professionals in a collaborative environment. You will gain valuable experience in requirements gathering, solution design, and stakeholder management.

**Who are we?**

Customer Capabilities is a diverse tribe of 130+ colleagues working in 14 cross-functional squads across Denmark, Lithuania, and India. Together, we design, build, and operate end-to-end solutions that support millions of customers and colleagues across Danske Bank. Our responsibilities span critical domains including Fees, Interest, Tax Reporting, Customer Communication, Document archiving, and modernisation of customer communication platforms. We combine strong execution with a people-first mindset, celebrating successes, building collaboration across geographies, and creating an environment where people can thrive and grow.

**What you will be doing**

You will join the Implementation and Adoption team, working closely with business stakeholders and technology professionals to create solutions that meets business requirements. You will collaborate with QA & Testing, Architecture, and Engineering teams to ensure our solutions are both functional and well-designed. Your work will directly contribute to how Danske Bank delivers technology solutions that satisfy business requirements.

* Partner with business stakeholders to gather and analyse requirements
* Translate business needs into clear functional specifications
* Perform analysis of datasets
* Collaborate with technical teams to align solution designs
* Contribute to project delivery within established frameworks

The weekly working hours are around 20 hours per week, based at our office in Postbyen, Copenhagen. Our working language is English.

**About you**

* Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving abilities
* Effective communication skills with both business and technical audiences
* Ability to work independently while contributing to team objectives
* Curios about how business and technology is supported by AI
* Familiarity with tools such as Excel or SQL
* Fluent in English
* Currently enrolled in a Master’s degree program, or in the final year of a Bachelor’s degree with plans to start a Master’s program after the summer

Experience with requirements gathering, project management tools, or business analysis would be valuable additions to your profile.

**Are you ready for the next step?**

This is an excellent opportunity to start your career in technology business solutions with a team that values learning and development. If you are interested in this role, please reach out to Thomas Aagaard at [thaa@danskebank.dk](mailto:thaa@danskebank.dk) or submit your application by 28 October 2026. We look forward to hearing from you!

We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

#st
